paperTitle: QLattes: An Open-Source Browser Extension for Brazilian Academic CV Data Analysis
centralContribution: QLattes is an open-source browser extension for Chrome and Firefox designed to automatically classify, annotate, filter, analyze, and visualize journal publication data from Brazil's Lattes CV platform using CAPES' former Qualis ranking system. This paper presents its architecture, implementation, and a comprehensive analysis of its real-world usage through Google Analytics data (over 27,000 weekly active users by October 2025) and an online survey of 1,495 participants, revealing distinct user profiles (e.g., high-frequency 'power users' for administrative tasks) and feature priorities across occupations and regions.

units.title: Abstract: QLattes Overview
units.summary: QLattes solves Lattes/Qualis integration issues, showing high adoption and po...

content.description: The Brazilian academic evaluation system, centered on the Lattes platform and CAPES' Qualis ranking, suffered from a lack of integration, forcing manual and cumbersome cross-referencing of publication venues. This inefficiency was exacerbated by the discontinuation of the Qualis system in May 2025. QLattes, an open-source browser extension, addresses this by automatically classifying and visualizing Qualis data on Lattes CVs. Implemented client-side with standard web technologies, it integrates three Qualis data sources and applies specific classification rules. The paper evaluates its significant adoption (over 27,000 weekly active users) and positive user experience through Google Analytics and a user survey, demonstrating its value in streamlining academic evaluation, despite limitations like reliance on HTML parsing and single-author focus.

content.caption: Figure 8. Example of a Lattes CV page annotated by the QLattesCC prototype, a new variant of QLattes tailored for computer science researchers. The tool annotates both journal articles and conference papers with relevant classification and citation metrics. The callouts highlight the key enhancements: 1. Journal Qualis rank based on CAPES classification; 2. Estimated Qualis rank inferred from Scopus and JCR metrics; 3. Conference Qualis rank from the CAPES Qualis Eventoss database; and 4. Conference identification method based on string similarity to known venues.
